scope: Bounded source review of all Razor views in CRM, Ecommerce, FixedAssets, HRPayroll, BusinessPolicy and AIManager, associated fixed AI templates, translation hooks and current dictionary coverage.
limitations: No build or browser/native-language acceptance was performed during this source review.
Marker/dictionary presence is not linguistic correctness, layout acceptance, accessibility acceptance or complete server-validation localization.
Direct exception-literal inventory is bounded; framework-generated and helper-constructed validation messages are described as unresolved surfaces rather than claimed exhaustive.
Files may be updated by their owners after this timestamp; SHA-256 snapshots identify the reviewed source.

unsafeTranslationWrappers.conclusion: No identified translation wrapper encloses raw user-entered names, contact details, descriptions, notes, references, policy evidence, reasons or custodian text in the reviewed views. Controlled status/method/title/AI checklist keys are app-owned. Typed Ecommerce tax option template preserves raw code/version/rate.
